name: Archimedes Tech SPAC Partners III Co.
summary: Archimedes Tech SPAC Partners III Co. is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC), specifically created to complete a business combination. This could involve various transaction types, such as a merger, an asset or stock acquisition, or a corporate reorganization, with one or more existing enterprises. The firm was established on August 1, 2025, and its primary office is situated in Claymont, Delaware.
